description: Search every indexed website. Returns ranked markdown passages with the source URL, heading path, and a relevance score. Pass `site` to scope to one domain.

query.description: What you are trying to find, e.g. 'does PostHog have a SOC2 report' or 'stripe webhook signature verification'

site.description: Optional: scope to a single domain, e.g. 'posthog.com' or 'supabase.com'

top_k.description: How many passages to return (default 20, max 50)

name: sitedex_search
